scene.bubble: Breaking news: Kili's lost-and-found box is FULL. Whose are all these things?
scene.intro: Breaking news: Kili's lost-and-found box is completely FULL. Whose scarf is this? It's Ingrid's. Whose notebook is this? Not mine — it's his. Diego holds up a very strange hat and nobody claims it: it isn't ours, it isn't theirs, and it certainly isn't hers. Kili keeps it for himself. Whose things are lost in your classroom? Ask around and give them back!

His whole collection is orange. … Diego: A little bell on a red ribbon? … Diego: Kili, that's yours! It's from your mail bag! … Diego: And the last thing… a torch. Hmm. Oh! It's mine!
